description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class for managing and interacting with an Android managed profile. It provides functions such as enabling/disabling apps, setting app restrictions, configuring intent forwarding, and wiping profile data, typically for device administration purposes in enterprise or managed device setups.

classes.name: BasicManagedProfileFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI and logic to manage a managed profile, including app control, restrictions, and data wipe functionality.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes application enabled statuses upon attaching to activity.

methods.name: isApplicationEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether a specified app is available and not hidden in the managed profile.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI event listeners and toggle states.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events for various profile management actions.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle switch changes for enabling/disabling apps.

methods.name: setAppEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an app in the profile via DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: setChromeRestrictions
methods.description: Applies restrictions to the Chrome app in the profile.

methods.name: clearChromeRestrictions
methods.description: Clears restrictions set on the Chrome app.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends a sample intent to demonstrate forwarding.

methods.name: removeProfile
methods.description: Wipes the managed profile's data, effectively removing it.
